scripts.export-android-windows: yarn windows-version && react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output output\index.android.bundle --assets-dest output --sourcemap-output output\sourcemap.js && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path output\index.android.bundle,output\*.png,output\*.jpg -DestinationPath output\index.android.bundle.zip -Force" && powershell -Command "Compress-Archive -Path output\sourcemap.js -DestinationPath output\sourcemap.zip -Force" && powershell -Command "Get-ChildItem -Path output | Where-Object { $_.Name -notlike '*.zip' -and $_.Name -ne 'version.json' } | Remove-Item -Recurse -Force"
scripts.windows-version: powershell -Command "if (Test-Path data/version.json) { $json = Get-Content data/version.json | ConvertFrom-Json; $json.version++; $json.timestamp = [int][double]::Parse(([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds())); $json | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Out-File -FilePath data/version.json -Encoding utf8 -Force } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path output | Out-Null; [PSCustomObject]@{version=1; downloadAndroidUrl='https://burak-ayd.github.io/AstorTest/output/index.android.bundle.zip'; downloadIosUrl='https://burak-ayd.github.io/AstorTest/output/main.jsbundle.zip'; timestamp=[int][double]::Parse(([DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()))} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Out-File -FilePath data/version.json -Encoding utf8 -Force }"
scripts.export-android-linux: yarn linux-version && react-native bundle   --platform android   --dev false   --entry-file index.js   --bundle-output output/index.android.bundle   --assets-dest output   --sourcemap-output output/sourcemap.js && (cd output && zip -j ../index.android.bundle.zip index.android.bundle *.png *.jpg 2>/dev/null || true) && zip -j output/sourcemap.zip output/sourcemap.js && find output -type f ! -name '*.zip' ! -name 'version.json' -delete
scripts.linux-version: if [ -f data/version.json ]; then jq '.version += 1 | .timestamp = (now | floor)' data/version.json > output/version.tmp && mv output/version.tmp data/version.json; else mkdir -p output && jq -n --arg android 'https://burak-ayd.github.io/AstorTest/output/index.android.bundle.zip' --arg ios 'https://burak-ayd.github.io/AstorTest/output/main.jsbundle.zip' '{version:1, downloadAndroidUrl:$android, downloadIosUrl:$ios, timestamp:(now | floor)}' > data/version.json; fi
scripts.export-ios: mkdir -p ios/output && npx expo export:embed --platform ios --entry-file node_modules/expo/AppEntry.js --bundle-output ios/output/main.jsbundle --dev false  --assets-dest ios/output
